selection.name: Worktrunk (C09)
selection.role: Separate agent edits through Git worktrees, with creation, switching, hooks and removal. Pair with a restriction runtime when enforcement is required.
selection.install_command: cargo install worktrunk && wt config shell install

basis.shows: Direct capability fit: separate working directories for Claude Code and Codex sessions; agent-launch commands and lifecycle hooks. Documents Linux/macOS installation, cargo test, and shell integration tests.
Released September 27, 2026. Upstream reports picker work starting at 47 ms per row versus 120 ms on a 50-worktree repository; this is a project-specific measurement, not an isolation comparison.
Default-branch commit dated October 1, 2026, within the 90-day currency window.

selection.name: sandbox-runtime (C01)
selection.role: Provisional choice for task-specific filesystem/network enforcement. Wrap commands or MCP servers with srt; configure sensitive-file read restrictions explicitly because reads are unrestricted by default. Linux x86_64 and macOS mechanisms are documented; WSL2 and macOS arm64 execution remain unmeasured.
selection.install_command: sudo apt-get install bubblewrap socat ripgrep && npm install -g @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime

basis.shows: Documents process-tree filesystem restrictions, Linux bubblewrap/network namespaces, domain-filtering proxies, macOS Seatbelt, srt CLI and MCP wrapping. Developed for Claude Code; generic CLI invocation is available to agents.
Documents npm test, typechecking and linting, and states that CI builds seccomp before tests on both Linux architectures. Actual CI outcomes were not verified.
Released September 30, 2026; release notes describe test-validity repairs, write-policy tests and Linux enforcement fixes. These establish maintenance activity, not comparative security superiority.
Default-branch commit dated October 1, 2026; raises the supported Node floor to 22.12. Ubuntu user-namespace prerequisites also need checking before installation.

not_selected.name: gVisor
not_selected.reason: Credible userspace-kernel OCI boundary, with documented unit/integration test commands; target-host workload compatibility and a cleanup/enforcement advantage remain unverified. [Pinned README](https://github.com/google/gvisor/blob/d3d566ad1979a92cb76918a18cba6e51fe252393/README.md).

not_selected.name: microsandbox
not_selected.reason: Local Linux execution requires KVM; KVM readiness inside the target WSL2 instance and comparative workload results remain unverified. Apple Silicon support is documented. [Upstream CLI documentation](https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/blob/main/docs/cli/overview.mdx).

not_selected.name: Docker Engine / Moby
not_selected.reason: Active OCI alternative; no completed target-host boundary/resource/cleanup comparison justifies selecting it over the provisional native boundary. Latest inspected release is docker-v29.8.2, September 30, 2026. [Release](https://github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/docker-v29.8.2).

not_selected.name: boxlite
not_selected.reason: Credible embedded microVM option, but Linux KVM availability and target-workload evidence remain unverified; upstream documents Linux x86_64 and Apple Silicon prerequisites. [Upstream cookbook](https://github.com/boxlite-ai/boxlite-cookbook/blob/main/README.md).

not_selected.name: Podman / Quadlet
not_selected.reason: Credible rootless OCI alternative and the proposed comparison arm; boundary selection remains open pending enforcement/resource/cleanup testing on WSL2. [Upstream README](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/main/README.md).

not_selected.name: e2b-dev/e2b
not_selected.reason: The inspected repository supplies SDK/CLI API operations; upstream places local self-hosting in a separate runtime stack, making this a less direct per-command host installation. Payment is not established as mandatory. [Release](https://github.com/e2b-dev/E2B/releases/tag/e2b%402.52.0), [upstream architecture](https://github.com/e2b-dev).

excluded.name: Apple Container
excluded.fact: Requires an Apple Silicon Mac and supported macOS 26; it cannot supply the primary Linux x86_64 WSL2 host runtime. It fits the secondary Mac host. [Upstream requirements](https://github.com/apple/container/blob/main/README.md#requirements).

layers.deciding_comparison: Keep Worktrunk for edit separation. Compare sandbox-runtime v0.0.78 with rootless Podman v6.1.3 on the same WSL2 Ubuntu instance, using the intended untrusted agent workload and equivalent access policies. Measure denied reads/writes, symlink and child-process behavior, TCP/UDP/IPv6 and Unix-socket containment, CPU/RAM/PID limits, permitted workload completion, and residual processes/files after exit, cancellation and forced termination. Repeat compatibility checks on macOS arm64. The native boundary selection is provisional; no measured superiority is claimed.
evidence_gaps: The packet contains no completed comparison where every named arm ran.
All nine repositories were non-archived and had default-branch commits and releases within 90 days. Recent merged-PR/release activity was observed; issue response and closure rates were not audited.

Published test commands and release notes were inspected, but successful test runs, coverage and current CI conclusions were not independently verified. Worktrunk's reported timing does not decide boundary quality.

WSL2 enforcement, macOS arm64 execution, resource ceilings and forced-termination cleanup were not measured. Linux support alone does not prove WSL2 compatibility. GPU access was not required by this packet and was not assessed.

Budget used: 30 GitHub API calls, 6 web search queries, and 8 attempted page URLs; no page-fetch attempt retrieved content. Documentation was verified through accessible GitHub API READMEs and primary-source search results.
